algorithm.scope: Pure synthetic identity; no ADL trigger, rank, real fill, liquidation or current eligibility inference

disclosure.scope: Authored documentary conclusions and labeled synthetic diagnostics. Captures, local paths and operational source stay local.

limitations: Documentary mechanism only; no real target ADL events or historical economic sample.
54 fixed synthetic scenarios and author self-checks are not empirical PnL or independent review.
Same-path symmetric algebra is not BTC/ETH beta neutrality or executable hedge.
Current exact contract/account applicability, actual costs, event price/size and source coverage unknown.

parameters.cases: all 54 Cartesian combinations; do not select winner; no empirical event frequency or expected loss
parameters.costs: price component only; actual fees, funding, slippage and ADL close price unknown. Event price is explicit scenario, not assumed execution mark.
parameters.exposure: same-path ideal symmetric pair is algebraic counterexample, NOT BTC/ETH beta neutrality or an executable hedge
parameters.formula: event-aware price component = s*a*(Pe-P0) + s*(1-a)*(PT-P0) - s*(PT-P0); difference versus intact ideal same-path pair = s*a*(Pe-PT). Residual signed units=-s*a.
parameters.selftests: hand checks zero/full/half reduction, both signs; then full Decimal cases and Fraction cross-check
